# dnscrypt-proxy2 blocklist (domain-only format)
# One domain per line
# 
# This file should be generated by update_blocklists.sh script
# which downloads Pi-hole compatible blocklists and converts them
# to domain-only format required by dnscrypt-proxy2
#
# Initially populated with common ad/malware domains.
# Run: /usr/local/etc/dnscrypt-proxy/update_blocklists.sh
#

twitter.com
